purpose: Matched generic shared-interface baseline on value-paired semantic updates; parameter sharing is not yet a semantic architecture.
objective: Only gold numeric-answer plus newline LM cross-entropy, identical for all arms. No auxiliary consistency loss or external scope labels.
gate: Require completed audited frozen native validation on the same registration and at least one erroneous readout. If native is perfect, do not train these adapters merely to create an effect.
requirements: Use exactly one unchanged ordered pass through all 864 training examples, with two microbatches per optimizer step. No original test, reused benchmark, training seed tuning or validation checkpoint selection.
Initialize fresh zero-output controllers; actual local projection counts must match the registered budgets, which are near-matched rather than identical. Preserve native attention output gates.

All backbone parameters remain frozen. Verify exact zero-init/detach restoration, finite adapter gradients, and for question-only adaptation exact sampled pre-question KV/recurrent/convolution/logit identity after a nonzero update and at the final checkpoint.

Checkpoint only adapters, AdamW moments and RNG at the three fixed boundaries. Only final weights receive semantic validation, all 432 examples; measure final teacher-forced fit on all 864 training examples separately from unrestricted validation answers.

Retain complete four-value groups, all three roles and before/control/treatment; report semantic joint correctness and preservation regressions. Equal/different wrong outputs are not update/ordering success.
Observe actual nonzero record attention at all six full-attention layers on prescribed sampled final contexts; no oracle evidence masks or dependency labels are supplied at inference.

Compare shared against independent, ordinary local and question-only local alternatives. Success here is feasibility evidence only; a final architecture needs fresh cohort and initialization confirmation plus a concrete semantic mechanism.
interpretation: Same executable dependence data and LM loss control the training-data explanation. A failed generic shared bottleneck does not refute every possible semantic controller, and a gain does not establish a semantic interface. Question-only success would weaken the claim that changing prefix writes is required.
